messages:
lina_cs: Quick sync — Arcadia Labs asked for a recurring enablement slot to get their Dedicated migration over the line. Thinking weekly office hours for 6 weeks + one focused deep-dive. Who can lead and what times work?

miguel_csm: I can lead. Wed mornings PT usually works for them. Wed 9am PT -> 17:00 UK / 18:00 CET.

alex_enable: Wed 9am PT is fine for engineering presence. I can cover runtime tuning and batching tips.

jordan_success: FYI their renewal is a soft risk if we don’t show cost improvements by month end — please include a concrete cost-savings session (quantization + cache).

lina_cs: Good call. Proposed pattern: weekly office hours (Q&A + triage) + every 3rd week a focused workshop (hands-on cost tuning). Draft agenda below:

```
- 00-10m: quick status & wins
- 10-25m: feature/topic deep-dive (week-specific)
- 25-50m: hands-on lab or triage (share configs/logs)
- 50-60m: action items & feedback form
```

lina_cs: For week-specific topics: 1) dedicated migration checklist, 2) batching & KV cache, 3) quantization profiles and perf regressions, 4) rollout + fallback strategies, 5) cost monitoring + token breakdowns, 6) open triage.

sarah_ops: I can spin up a calendar poll. Quick poll options — react with the number you prefer: :one: Wed 9am PT, :two: Tue 8am PT, :three: Thu 10am PT. Also how long per session? 60m or 45m?

miguel_csm: :one: and 60m please. We need time for labs.

alex_enable: :one: + 60m. I'll prep a short runbook and a small repo with example configs.

jordan_success: :one: as well. Can we block a pre-read doc for Arcadia's CSM? They have bespoke prompt-routing that will need attention.

lina_cs: On pre-read — can the CSM export the last 3 days of request traces and a sample prompt set? We'll use that in the triage lab.

onboard-bot: Calendar poll created: https://doodle.com/arcadia-officehours (expires in 3 days). Recurring workspace channel: #arcadia-office-hours.

sarah_ops: Tentative channel created and invite sent to Arcadia's primary contacts. I also created the recurring 6-week slot placeholder starting 2026-04-07 (will finalize after poll).

alex_enable: For feedback capture, I’ll attach a 3-question form at the end of each session: 1) Was this actionable? 2) Most helpful topic? 3) Any blockers remaining? Link: https://forms.gle/arcadia-feedback-temp

jordan_success: Also request a short health-check metric snapshot from the customer before week 1: avg latency, tokens per request, top 5 endpoints by volume. That’ll help prioritize.

lina_cs: Agreed. I'll send a template to Arcadia with the exact fields to fill.

sarah_ops: Booking note: I'll invite: miguel_csm, alex_enable, lina_cs, platform-ops alias, and Arcadia contacts. If anyone else should be on the host roster, ping me.

miguel_csm: Can engineering bring a short rollback/runbook for model switch? Last time they hit a soft regression and needed a fallback.

alex_enable: Will prepare a 5-slide runbook + a small script snippet for safe rollback.

lina_cs: Perfect. Next steps: 1) everyone react to poll, 2) jordan to confirm renewal risk details to tailor cost session, 3) sarah to finalize invites after poll, 4) alex to prep repos + feedback form, 5) miguel to lead week1.

jordan_success: I'll follow up with Arcadia CSM to get the health snapshot and renewals context today.

onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: send pre-read request 7 days before week1.

sarah_ops: Noted — will also set a post-session feedback reminder 1 hour after each session.

lina_cs: Thanks team. If poll closes and :one: wins, I’ll post the final agenda and the pre-read template in the channel.

miguel_csm: Thanks — looking forward to it.

alex_enable: Quick note — bring logs redacted to avoid PII, prefer sanitized snapshots.

jordan_success: Acknowledged.

sarah_ops: All set on my end for ops.

lina_cs: Closing the thread — will update once poll done. :thumbsup:
